name: A1 · Original (current)
summary: The A look you approved: side-part hair, clean-shaven, navy polo with gold collar and sleeve trims.
strengths: Easiest to animate consistently (flat layers, few gradients)
Warm and approachable without looking childish
risks: Can look generic if expressions are under-used
Needs a disciplined colour/line spec to stay premium
rig: Layered SVG cut-out rig (this repo): bone angles for arms/legs, 6-viseme mouth set, blink and brow controls. Portable to Rive or Moho later.

effort.consistency: Very high (same vector parts every frame)
